experiment.central_question: Can the frozen post-HC-1 Health Foundation manufacture and certify copayment and waiting-period knowledge for a contamination-free neutral unseen Health product without new runtime logic or a new semantic/spec structural shape?

insurers_excluded_due_to_prior_cold_star: Star Health & Allied Insurance Co. Ltd.
Bajaj General Insurance Limited / Bajaj Allianz General Insurance Company Limited
HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited
Tata AIG General Insurance Company Limited
Niva Bupa Health Insurance Co. Ltd.

allowed_source_classes: current regulator insurer list or insurer registry page
official insurer non-policy HTML product catalogue/download index
official insurer disclaimer or product-list page that contains product identity/UIN only
official regulator or insurer product/UIN table explicitly limited to product metadata
prohibited_source_classes_before_selecti: FAQ or marketing page containing target-concept mechanics
search-result or AI-generated snippet containing copayment or waiting-period mechanics for a candidate insurer/product
preselection_metadata_firewall.contamination_rule: If any prohibited source returns target-concept mechanics for an insurer before Product #7 selection is committed, immediately stop screening that insurer, record the exposure, exclude that insurer from Product #7, and continue to the next insurer. Do not use the exposed content for selection.
preselection_metadata_firewall.metadata_insufficiency_rule: If current product identity, UIN, current-offering status, retail Health indemnity classification, and individual/family-floater availability cannot be established from allowed metadata-only sources, the candidate is not metadata-verifiable and is excluded without opening a prohibited document.

selection_protocol.insurer_sort: normalized insurer legal/display name lower-case ASCII ascending
selection_protocol.screening_rule: Screen non-excluded insurers in order using only allowed metadata sources until the first insurer has at least one metadata-verifiable eligible product with no governed exact-UIN exposure at the frozen baseline.
selection_protocol.stopping_rule: Stop at the first eligible uncontaminated insurer.
selection_protocol.selected_insurer_ledger_rule: Enumerate all metadata-verifiable current retail Health indemnity products for individual and/or family-floater purchase from that insurer using only allowed metadata sources. Record eligible and excluded products with metadata reasons.
selection_protocol.product_tie_break: Sort eligible products by normalized UIN/product identifier ascending and select the first.

classification_rubric.REUSE: Baseline generic contracts, binders, certifiers, semantic types, governed spec schemas and evidence-attribution shapes handle the concept unchanged.
classification_rubric.CONFIG_SPEC: Frozen runtime remains unchanged but a new governed declarative structural shape is required; no executable decision logic may be hidden in it.
classification_rubric.REPRESENTATION_GAP: Authoritative evidence is sufficient but the frozen baseline cannot faithfully represent or certify the semantic shape.
classification_rubric.KNOWLEDGE_GAP: Reviewed authoritative/corroborating evidence is insufficient; code, config or DomainKnowledge cannot compensate.

success_bar.STRONG_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN: Both target concepts are REUSE and every primary metric remains zero.
success_bar.MINIMUM_REPEATABILITY_PROVEN: Both target concepts are REUSE or CONFIG_SPEC, at least one is REUSE, no REPRESENTATION_GAP occurs, and every primary metric remains zero.
success_bar.REPEATABILITY_NOT_PROVEN: Any primary metric is non-zero, any target concept is REPRESENTATION_GAP, or both scoreable concepts are CONFIG_SPEC with zero REUSE.
success_bar.REPEATABILITY_INCONCLUSIVE: At least one target concept is KNOWLEDGE_GAP and no architecture/repeatability failure otherwise occurs.

required_artifacts_before_semantic_revie: complete metadata-only ledger for the selected insurer
attestation that no prohibited product document was opened for the selected insurer before selection merge
